description: The contract's grading dimensions (spec_fidelity/test_coverage/code_correctness/security_compliance/purity_boundary with percentage weights 25/25/25/15/10) do not match the VCSDD standard review dimensions (spec_fidelity/edge_case_coverage/implementation_correctness/structural_integrity/verification_readiness). The Phase 3 adversary will review using the standard 5 dimensions, but the contract's pass criteria are defined against non-standard dimensions. This means there is no way to evaluate 'edge_case_coverage' or 'structural_integrity' using the contract's own grading rubric, and no contract-level pass threshold applies to those dimensions.
